# Tjenesteplan (dutyplan)

> A duty planner for any group (a church, a choir, a club): who does which task on which day. Organisations have plans;
> a plan has events (dates), tasks with a number of places per event, and everyone's answers per event. A planner makes a
> fair draft; people can be set by hand. This file is for agents (LLMs) that use a Tjenesteplan server: what is in it, how
> to put a whole plan in at once, and the API. Source and docs: https://github.com/gunnaringe/dutyplan

## The ideas

- **Organisation** (`org`, addressed by its slug): has members, tasks, people and plans. Members are `admin` (members,
  invitations, renaming and deleting the organisation) or `member` (everything else).
- **Task**: a job, e.g. «Sound», «Coffee». The organisation's own, the same in every plan, in an order.
- **Person**: someone who can be given tasks (a name only; no contact details are stored). Per task: `good` (gladly),
  `poor` (if needed) or not at all. `proposable: false` = the planner never picks them.
- **Plan**: e.g. «Spring 2027». Has **events** (a date, optional start/end time `HH:MM`, a description), **places** (how
  many people a task needs on an event; 0 = not needed), **details rows** (`fields`: one text per event, e.g. «Theme»),
  **answers** (per person and event: `good`, `poor`, `never`, or none) with an optional **note**, and **hand-set cells**.
- **Draft**: a run of the planner (`runs`); one can be pinned as the current plan.
- **Links**: a `view` or `edit` link gives access to one plan without an account; a `join` link invites a member.

## Putting a whole plan in at once (import)

The one who runs the server can import a plan, all or nothing:

    dutyplan import --org <org-slug> [--db dutyplan.db] [--dry-run] plan.json     (or - for standard input)

`--dry-run` checks everything and stores nothing. The plan must be new. Tasks are matched by name (case does not matter);
missing ones are made, in the order given. People and answers are not imported: people answer for themselves. The output
is one line of JSON: the plan, the new tasks, the number of events and places.

```json
{
  "plan": "Spring 2031",
  "tasks": ["Sound", "Coffee", "Welcome"],
  "fields": ["Theme"],
  "events": [
    {"date": "2031-01-12", "start_time": "11:00", "description": "Service",
     "fields": {"Theme": "Light"}, "places": {"Sound": 1, "Coffee": 2}},
    {"date": "2031-01-15", "description": "Prayer evening"},
    {"date": "2031-01-19", "start_time": "11:00", "end_time": "12:30", "places": {"Sound": 1, "Welcome": 1}}
  ]
}
```

Limits: names 1–80 characters, at most 50 places per task and event, details values at most 200 characters, and the
organisation's limits on plans, tasks and events. Unknown keys are refused. Moving a spreadsheet: one event per date
column, one task per role row; leave names out unless the people themselves agreed.

## The API

JSON over HTTP under `/api`. Writes send `Content-Type: application/json`. Access is by signing in (a session cookie
from OpenID Connect) or a share link's cookie (`/s/{token}`); there are no API keys. A `view` link may only read; an
`edit` link reaches its own plan only. Errors are `{"error": "...", "code": "...", "params": {...}, "message": "..."}` with a status:
400 invalid (`code` says why, e.g. `name_invalid`, `nothing_to_change`), 401 signed out, 403 not allowed (`read_only`,
`admin_only`), 404 not found (also for what belongs to another organisation), 409 conflict, 429 too many changes.
Writes answer 204 (or 200/201 with the thing). Ids are numbers; `{org}` and `{plan}` are slugs.

### Server and you
- `GET /api/health` — `{"ok": true, "planner": bool}`.
- `GET /api/me` — who is signed in, and the share links in this browser.
- `GET /api/orgs` — the organisations you reach. `POST /api/orgs` `{"name"}` — make one (you become its admin).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}` — the organisation, with your `role`, or a link's `level` and `plan`.
- `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}` `{"name"}` — rename (admin). `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}?confirm={org}` — delete it and everything (admin).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/stream` — server-sent events: a line per change, so a page can fetch again.

### Members and links
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/members` — members with a login. `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/members/{id}` `{"role"}` (admin).
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/members/{id}` — remove (admin), or leave (yourself).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/links` — the share links. `POST /api/orgs/{org}/links` `{"plan", "level": "view"|"edit"|"join", "label", "expires_days"}`
  (`join` is for admins and has no plan). `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/links/{id}`.

### Tasks, people, sections (the organisation's own)
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/tasks`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/tasks` `{"name"}`, `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/tasks/{id}` `{"name", "planned"}`,
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/tasks/{id}`, `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/tasks/{id}/position` `{"position"}`.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/combinations` — which tasks one person can do on the same event.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/combinations` `{"a", "b", "level": "cannot"|"practical"|"standard"}`;
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/tasks/{id}/combinations` `{"level"}` — one task against all others.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/people`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/people` `{"name"}`, `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/people/{id}` `{"name", "proposable"}`,
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/people/{id}/position` `{"section", "position"}`.
- `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/people/{id}/tasks/{task}` `{"level": "good"|"poor"}`, `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/people/{id}/tasks/{task}`.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/sections`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/sections` `{"name"}`, `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/sections/{id}` `{"name"}`,
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/sections/{id}/position` `{"position"}`, `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/sections/{id}` — headings for people; placement only.

### Plans and events
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans` `{"name"}`, `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}`,
  `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}` `{"name"}` (the slug stays), `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}`.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events` `{"date", "until", "every", "start_time", "end_time"}`
  (`every` N weeks until `until` makes a series, at most every 8 weeks), `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}` `{"start_time", "end_time", "description"}`,
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}`.
- `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}/copy` `{"dates" | "until"+"every", "times", "start_time", "end_time", "details", "places", "hand"}` — copies of an event.

### The table
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/places` — places per event and task.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}/places/{task}` `{"slots"}`,
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}/places/{task}` — back to none.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/tasks/{id}/places` `{"slots"}` — every event of the plan.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/places` `{"places": [{"event", "task", "slots"}]}` — many at once (at most 5000).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/fields` — details rows and their values. `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/fields` `{"name"}`,
  `PATCH /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/fields/{id}` `{"name"}`, `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/fields/{id}/position` `{"position"}`,
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/fields/{id}`, `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}/fields/{field}` `{"value"}` ("" removes).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/answers` — `{"events": [{"person_id", "event_id", "level"}], "tasks": [...], "notes": [{"person_id", "event_id", "note"}]}`.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/people/{id}/availability` `{"levels": {"<event id>": "good"|"poor"|"never"|""}}` — one person.
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/answers` `{"answers": [{"person", "event", "level"}]}` — many at once (at most 5000).
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/events/{id}/notes/{person}` `{"note"}` — a note on an answer, at most 300 characters ("" removes).
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/cells`, `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/cells` `{"event", "task", "person" | "label", "fills", "locked"}`,
  `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/cells/{id}` — places set by hand.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/pools`, `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/pools` `{"event", "task", "people"}` — choose only among these.

### The planner
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/weights`, `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/weights` `{"values"}` — what the planner weighs.
- `POST /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/runs` `{"time_limit"}` — make a draft. `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/runs` — the drafts;
  `GET /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/runs/{id}` (`latest` works as an id; `?lang=nb` for Norwegian explanations).
  `PUT /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/runs/{id}/pin`, `DELETE /api/orgs/{org}/plans/{plan}/runs/{id}/pin` — the current plan.
